column1: # Reference table of producer/consumer dependencies between Cratis repositories. cratis-local-packages.sh reads it to derive the pack plan.
# Tab-separated; # starts a comment; no versions (pins are read live from consumer manifests).
#   pack  <repo> <eco> <target> [PROP=VAL,...]  pack targets; PROP is a -p:PROP=VAL argument (never an environment variable)
# A target of "." means the repository root (npm workspaces).
# Chronicle (clients only; the kernel ships as an image)
